rule_name: Talking Heads, Anchor Dialogue in Physical Space
quote: There are a couple of things where she's slower than most kids her age
why: opens an eleven-line stretch (through line 95) of Ben/mom dialogue with no physical detail placing anyone in the hallway or the room beyond it
suggestion: drop in a beat every few lines, e.g. Ben capping and uncapping his pen, or Chloe shifting on the too-tall chair, to anchor the exchange in space.

why: part of a roughly sixteen-turn exchange (lines 81-97) carrying only two attribution tags total, forcing the reader to count quotation marks to track speakers
suggestion: "Then what do I do?" her mom says, still looking at the door.

why: the chapter uses ten section breaks (lines 17, 26, 32, 44, 52, 65, 77, 99, 115, 118) against Guide 2's stated maximum of 2-3 per chapter
suggestion: consolidate scenes to cut the break count to 2-3, merging adjacent short scenes (e.g. the blocks and words subtests) into continuous sections.
